findings.detail: ROW_TEXT = ("Signal purpose: ...",) at tests/graph/test_signal_vocabulary_store.py:66 is passed as text=$text into CREATE (r:PlantSignalRow {description:$text}) at line 120. iter_codex/discovery/signals/vocabulary_graph.py applies str() to the description, which on a list yields "['Signal purpose: ...']" including quotes and brackets. The quantity assertion still passes because the keyword inside the text survives, so the test measures less than its comment states and would keep passing if the row-text path broke in a way that only affected the bracketed form.
findings.summary: ROW_TEXT is a one-element tuple, so the vocabulary fixture stores a list where it means a string.
findings.text: ROW_TEXT is a one-element tuple rather than a string, and the fixture stores it as the description of the PlantSignalRow the vocabulary test reads its quantity from; the reader stringifies the value, so the test exercises a bracketed list repr in place of the row text it claims to model.

findings.detail: assert_approved at iter_codex/graph/plant_ontology_migration.py:110 is exercised once, by logs/negative-control-unapproved-label-20261123T215500Z.log, and the repeat-pass idempotency is exercised once, by the applied-run census. Both are evidence for this landing but neither is a regression guard: the schema roundtrip tests cover the schema side, nothing in tests/ imports plant_ontology_migration, and its APPROVED_LABELS/APPROVED_RELATIONSHIPS sets can be widened, or a migration step made non-idempotent, with a green suite. The graph-marked tests that do run need a live graph, so a cheap test over assert_approved's refusal alone would cover the contract the negative control demonstrates.
findings.summary: The migration module's refusal and idempotency are proven only by one-off run logs, not by a test.
findings.text: The 768-line migration module has no automated test; assert_approved, the per-step idempotency and restore are asserted only by one-off logs in the reviewed run's own directory, so a later edit can weaken the approved-label refusal without any test going red.
